About this Event

✨ Where accomplished South Asian professionals come to meet with intention.
We're redefining how South Asian professionals meet—with intention, not coincidence.
Stop paying for singles events only to spend the night standing around, wondering who to approach.
Too often, you're met with overcrowded rooms, uneven attendance, and little to no facilitation—leaving meaningful connections up to luck.
At Desi Matchmaking, we do things differently. Our experienced hosts actively introduce guests throughout the evening, creating natural conversations and connecting you with accomplished South Asian professionals who share your values, ambitions, lifestyle, and relationship goals.
No awkward first moves. No endless guessing. Just intentional introductions.
📍 Madam Ji Ki Shaadi – New York City
📅 Tuesday, Oct 27, 2026
🕔 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM
👥 Ages 26–49
🎟️ Tickets: $60
Your ticket includes one complimentary drink and an evening of thoughtfully curated introductions. Limited tickets are available, so reserve your spot early.
At Desi Matchmaking, we believe finding the right partner shouldn't depend on luck—it should begin with thoughtful introductions, meaningful conversations, and an environment designed to help real relationships grow. That's why every event is intentionally curated to help you meet accomplished South Asian professionals in a welcoming, relaxed setting where authentic connections can flourish.
Reserve your spot through the link in our bio before tickets sell out.
Tag a friend who's ready to meet someone with intention. ❤️
